questions.cardText:
[Zoology] Which mammal can reach the lowest core body temperature?
A. Arctic fox
B. Polar bear
C. Arctic ground squirrel
Answer: C. The Arctic ground squirrel can lower its core body temperature to as low as 26.8 °F (-2.9 °C) during hibernation, the lowest known of any mammal.
questions.de: Welches Säugetier kann seine Körperkerntemperatur im Winterschlaf auf etwa −2,9 °C senken, den niedrigsten bekannten Wert aller Säugetiere?
questions.en: Which mammal can lower its core body temperature during hibernation to about −2.9 °C, the lowest known of any mammal?

questions.cardText:
[History] The design of Liberia’s national flag is primarily influenced by which country’s flag?
A. Soviet Union
B. France
C. United States
Answer: C. The Liberian flag’s design reflects its founding by freed American and Caribbean slaves. Liberia was established as a U.S. colony, and its capital, Monrovia, is named after James Monroe, the fifth U.S. president.
questions.de: Vom Flaggenentwurf welches Landes ist die Nationalflagge Liberias vor allem beeinflusst?
questions.en: The design of Liberia's national flag is primarily influenced by which country's flag?

timeline.labelEn: Liberia adopts its national flag, modelled on the flag of the United States
timeline.labelDe: Liberia nimmt seine Nationalflagge an, nach dem Vorbild der Flagge der Vereinigten Staaten

questions.notes: Liberia was founded by the American Colonization Society, a private organization, rather than as an official U.S. government colony as the card says.
